methods.text_en: Present established scale through an overall spatial view without adding landmarks or destruction.
methods.text_zh: 用整体空间视野呈现已有规模，不新增地标或破坏。

methods.text_en: Use the source template's slow push toward the existing target while retaining orientation.
methods.text_zh: 采用来源模板的缓推接近既有目标，保持方位。
